plan.explanation: This process plan sequentially manufactures the synthetic component. It begins with face milling the datum surface (F1). Then, through-holes (F2, F3) are drilled and the pocket (F4) and (F5) are machined. Subsequent operations include reaming and drilling of F6, followed by tapping F8, and finally slotting F9.
assumptions: Synthetic component generated for software evaluation; not derived from real geometry.
Tool size, tool access, collisions and setups are not modelled.
Precedence constraints are generated demo assumptions, not general manufacturing rules.
uncertainties: The exact durations are estimates only and depend heavily on material, tool condition and cutting parameters.
